You work closely with our Platform Team and product engineering teams, and are responsible for the scalability, security, and resilience of our infrastructure. In practice, you will: Continuously refine and optimize our AWS infrastructure, with a sharp focus on scalability, maintainability, and security - you don't wait for something to break before improving it. Manage, monitor, and scale our Windows, SQL Server, and Linux servers, plus our Kubernetes (EKS) clusters, to keep everything highly available. Lead technical infrastructure projects end-to-end — from architecture design and testing to monitoring and security — partnering with product engineering teams on complex architecture needs. When you tune an EKS cluster or harden an IaC pipeline, it's the reason product teams can ship changes with confidence instead of crossing their fingers. When something in our infrastructure needs to scale under real customer load, your ownership is what keeps it standing. You operate with high autonomy here — this isn't a role where you wait for direction. The infrastructure decisions you make ripple out into how secure, fast, and resilient the product feels for the 140,000+ companies who depend on Yuki every day. You bring You're an analytical, inventive engineer who takes pride in system resilience and clean architecture. You thrive with high autonomy and freedom, matched by a strong sense of personal accountability. 5+ years of hands-on experience managing production environments on AWS, with deep expertise in core services: networking (VPC, subnets, routing, security groups), EC2/Auto Scaling, S3 storage tiers, and RDS (backup/restore, patching, performance tuning).
